en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes up 108 points at 24557 as financial and AI stocks gain
en.dek: The benchmark rose 0.44 per cent on Tuesday, with HSBC climbing more than 4 per cent while the Hang Seng Tech Index gained 1.08 per cent.
body: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index closed higher on Tuesday, rising 108.09 points or 0.44 per cent to finish at 24,557.04. The index had opened higher and touched an intraday high near 24,675 before settling for the day.

Financial and artificial-intelligence related stocks performed well, with HSBC Holdings rising more than 4 per cent. The Hang Seng Tech Index climbed 1.08 per cent to 4,084.45, while the Hang Seng China Enterprises Index edged up 0.07 per cent to 8,265.81.
Market turnover was moderate. The gains came after a quieter session the previous day and reflected strength in selected blue-chip counters.

zh.headline: 港股高收108點報24557 金融及AI股造好滙控升逾4%
zh.dek: 恒生指數周二升0.44%，滙控升逾百分之四，恒生科技指數升1.08%。
body: 港股周二高收，恒生指數上升108.09點或百分之0.44，收報24557.04點。指數高開後一度高見約24675點，其後回穩收市。
金融及人工智能相關股份表現理想，滙控升逾百分之四。恒生科技指數升百分之1.08報4084.45點，國企指數微升百分之0.07報8265.81點。
大市成交適中。升幅出現在前一交易日較為平靜之後，主要受部分藍籌股帶動。
